en: Fixed sessions on self-hosted environments not starting from a git remote with an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates or a GHE.com SSH user; an unresolved alias's error gives two git commands
zh: 修复了自托管环境中的 session 无法从带有 SSH 主机别名、GitHub SSH 证书或 GHE.com SSH 用户的 git 远程启动的问题；未解析别名的错误会给出两条 git 命令
